title.value: Modeling electronic health record data using a knowledge-graph-embedded topic model
title.justification: The paper focuses on a model called KG-ETM, which is used to distill disease topics from EHR data using knowledge graphs.
title.quote: We present KG-ETM, an end-to-end knowledge graph-based multimodal embedded topic model.

extractions.description: The paper introduces KG-ETM, a knowledge-graph-embedded topic model to distill disease topics from electronic health record (EHR) data using medical knowledge graphs. It enhances the extraction of medical concepts from large-scale EHR datasets for various clinical applications such as patient stratification and drug recommendations.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper's main concentration is on improving medical data analysis and patient stratification within health informatics, without a direct emphasis on ecological or climate sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: We present KG-ETM... to distill latent disease topics from EHR data by learning embedding from the medical knowledge graphs.

primary_category.justification: The research is centered on health informatics and enhancing patient data analysis, which does not directly contribute to any defined climate or ecological sustainable development categories.
primary_category.quote: The rapid growth of electronic health record (EHR) datasets opens up promising opportunities to understand human diseases in a systematic way.

primary_sub_category.justification: No specific sub-category within climate or ecological sustainable development directly aligns with the focus on medical knowledge graph application in EHR data analysis.
primary_sub_category.quote: KG-ETM distills latent disease topics from EHR data by learning the embedding from the medical knowledge graphs.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper's exploration of using knowledge graphs to enhance electronic health records situates it within the domain of health informatics.
new_primary_category.quote: The rapid growth of electronic health record (EHR) datasets opens up promising opportunities to understand human diseases in a systematic way.

new_primary_sub_category.value: EHR Data Analysis and Patient Stratification
new_primary_sub_category.justification: The focus on leveraging knowledge graphs for the better analysis of EHR data and its application in patient stratification and drug recommendation is specific to health informatics, not present in existing sustainability categories.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: We applied KG-ETM to a large-scale EHR dataset consisting of over 1 million patients. We evaluated its performance based on EHR reconstruction and drug imputation.
